integrationReview.reason: RS256 service-token signing and verification are core gateway behavior.
integrationReview.contract: Bearer tokens are signed with JWT_PRIVATE_KEY and verified with JWT_PUBLIC_KEY while pinning header alg.
integrationReview.configuration: JWT_PRIVATE_KEY, JWT_PUBLIC_KEY, and ALLOW_HS256_FALLBACK environment configuration.
integrationReview.failureMode: Invalid or stale signatures are rejected with authentication failure.
integrationReview.validation: Run service-identity JWT and guard tests plus scripts/verify-service-tokens.sh after token changes.

integrationReview.reason: The gateway persists AI agents, Claude Code jobs, and inference logs through TypeORM.
integrationReview.contract: TypeORM entities ClaudeCodeJob, InferenceLog, and AiAgent are stored in PostgreSQL.
integrationReview.configuration: DATABASE_URL or DB_HOST, DB_PORT, DB_USER, DB_PASSWORD, and DB_NAME.
integrationReview.failureMode: Persistence-dependent AI and job operations cannot complete when the database is unavailable.
integrationReview.validation: Run maintained application tests and inspect TypeORM configuration in src/app.module.ts.

integrationReview.reason: The established SYSTEM.md database-server integration explicitly requires db-server-postgres:5432 plus Redis.
integrationReview.contract: Platform database-server contract includes Redis alongside PostgreSQL for this service.
integrationReview.configuration: Database-server environment configuration documented by the service deployment.
integrationReview.failureMode: The platform dependency is unavailable until database-server Redis connectivity is restored.
integrationReview.validation: Review the declared database-server integration in SYSTEM.md and deployment configuration.

integrationReview.reason: The service emits structured operational logs.
integrationReview.contract: LoggingClient POSTs service, level, message, timestamp, and metadata to /api/logs.
integrationReview.failureMode: Logging is best effort and must not crash the service.
integrationReview.validation: Run logging-client tests or inspect the structured logging client contract.

integrationReview.reason: The contract-violation filter sends configured notifications.
integrationReview.contract: Configured notification delivery uses the notifications/send endpoint.
integrationReview.configuration: NOTIFICATION_SERVICE_URL selects the notification service endpoint.
integrationReview.failureMode: Malformed notification configuration is ignored by the filter and does not block request handling.

Voice transcription retrieves audio objects before transcription.
integrationReview.contract: VoiceService fetches a file key from a configured MinIO-compatible bucket and endpoint.
integrationReview.failureMode: Missing or inaccessible audio returns a bad-request failure rather than a transcript.
integrationReview.validation: Run voice-service tests and review the configured storage fetch contract.

integrationReview.reason: Claude Code implementation jobs publish and consume RabbitMQ messages.
integrationReview.contract: Jobs publish to claude-code-exchange with claude-code.execute routing and are consumed by the job worker.
integrationReview.failureMode: A failed publish leaves the persisted job available for recovery; consumers retry work after backoff.
integrationReview.validation: Run Claude Code service and consumer tests.

integrationReview.reason: Project documentation must be discoverable while Git remains authoritative.
integrationReview.contract: The repository is ingested directly from Git for bounded documentation retrieval.
integrationReview.configuration: Ecosystem repository catalog controls repository discovery.
integrationReview.failureMode: When retrieval is unavailable or unconfident, agents verify against Git source.
integrationReview.validation: Confirm distinctive documentation content resolves to the repository path when retrieval is healthy.

integrationReview.contract: The public GET /health endpoint returns status and service identity.
integrationReview.configuration: Health controller and Kubernetes service probes expose the endpoint.
integrationReview.failureMode: An unhealthy application does not report a healthy health response.
integrationReview.validation: Request GET /health and run maintained controller tests.
